item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00158","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C18","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.999,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 is an unmistakable reusable template for the child. It reproduces the same lengthy Assignment of Claims Act quotation and the same recital-to-designation structure, with the operative language effectively identical except that “National Aeronautics and Space Administration” is replaced by “Federal Aviation Agency.” C18 has a similar statute-quotation and agency-designation structure but concerns a different statute and uses substantially different language. C03 involves contracting authority and the Federal Aviation Agency but does not match the child’s specific drafting machinery nearly as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS the Assignment of Claims Act of 1940 (54 Stat. 1029) as amended by the act of May 15, 1951, 65 Stat. 41 (31 U.S.C. 203), contains the following provisions","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS the Assignment of Claims Act of 1940, 54 Stat. 1029, as amended by the act of May 15, 1951, 65 Stat. 41 (31 U.S.C. 203), contains the following provisions","explanation":"The directives introduce the same statute with virtually identical wording and then reproduce the same lengthy statutory passage."},{"child_excerpt":"AND WHEREAS it appears that it would be in the public interest to make those provisions applicable to the Federal Aviation Agency","parent_excerpt":"AND WHEREAS it appears that it would be in the public interest to make those provisions applicable to the National Aeronautics and Space Administration","explanation":"The public-interest recital is identical apart from substituting the newly targeted agency."},{"child_excerpt":"NOW, THEREFORE, I hereby designate the Federal Aviation Agency as an agency of the United States to which such statutory provisions shall apply in the same manner and to the same extent that they apply to the Department of Defense, the General Services Administration, and the Atomic Energy Commission.","parent_excerpt":"NOW, THEREFORE, I hereby designate the National Aeronautics and Space Administration as an agency of the United States to which such statutory provisions shall apply in the same manner and to the same extent that they apply to the Department of Defense, the General Services Administration, and the Atomic Energy Commission.","explanation":"The complete operative provision is reused verbatim except for the agency name, demonstrating both literal copying and the same legal machinery."}]}
